description: He wears a long ochre-brown textured open-front coat with narrow gold-and-dark geometric borders at the front, cuffs and hem. Underneath is a cream long tunic with a decorated split neckline and full loose sleeves, over cream trousers gathered at the ankles. A brown and gold woven sash wraps the waist and hangs in a long fringed end. Dark brown closed leather shoes complete the outfit. The fabrics are opaque, lightly flowing and finely made without ceremonial display. No headgear, armor or weapon appears. The skin's healed facial line is visible; no clothing accessory covers the face. Exact textile fibers cannot be established visually.
